text: A.J. Pero, the longtime drummer for metal band Twisted Sister, died at 55 from what appeared to be a massive heart attack. He had complained of a sore arm while touring with Adrenaline Mob in Poughkeepsie, New York, and was found on his tour bus before being taken to a hospital. Bandmates called him a great drummer and brother.
